instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Mount fonts in frontend/src/index.css by importing '@fontsource-variable/manrope' and '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'. Set --font-sans to 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif and --font-mono to 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace.
2. Implement full Material Design 3 tokens as CSS variables in :root and .dark with support for dynamic seed color switching (store active palette in localStorage).
3. Build responsive M3 Navigation Bar at the bottom for mobile screens and Navigation Rail on wide desktop screens (>=768px).
4. Ensure Russian UI is default with complete bilingual dictionary for English (RU/EN toggle in top app bar or settings).
5. Implement active timer engine using accurate requestAnimationFrame or 1-second interval with timestamp diffing so time remains exact even if the tab is backgrounded.
6. Build full Calendar with interactive month grid, day shift markers, and smooth M3 bottom sheet on day tap.
7. Implement full-featured Shift Form supporting date, start/end time, breaks, shift type (day/night/weekend/overtime), hourly rate override, tax/bonuses, tags, notes, and recurring shift generator.
8. Implement Recharts statistics (hours distribution, earnings trends, shift types) with period filters.
9. Implement full JSON & CSV export and JSON import with file picker and data validation.
10. Preload realistic initial seed shifts into localStorage on first visit so the app looks lived-in and rich immediately.
11. Every interactive button, input, and KPI must include data-testid as specified.
